vulkan_release.result: PASS -- full experiment suite for this phase run for real against SmolLM2-135M/360M on the GTX 1650; ctest 68/69 or 69/69 depending on real-time host swap pressure (test_relocate_state, the one new test, always passes -- see regression.json for the unrelated test_mem_guard flake)

vulkan_asan_not_attempted: Same limitation and reasoning as Phase 12C: building a Vulkan+ASan/UBSan combination was judged too resource-risky on this 5.6 GiB host (a single CPU-only ASan rebuild of llama already needs ~580s and most of the machine's headroom), and Vulkan driver-side allocations are frequently not ASan-instrumented anyway. The real Vulkan-side correctness claims in this phase rest on the poison test (ground truth generation output), not on a sanitizer run -- and the one Vulkan-side memory-safety BUG this phase found (release_failure.json) was found WITHOUT a sanitizer, via a real crash, so the absence of Vulkan+ASan does not mean memory-safety issues went undetected here.
